verdicts.reason: A: the $49.99 dominates, but the grey, blue and red stripes are reduced to tiny slivers and a stray grey bar, so the brand look is mostly gone. The product list floats tiny above the price, 'for all drinkware on' is stranded far to the bottom right, and the rotated URL at the far left is too small to read, so the reading order is broken. B: it keeps the three brand stripes and the original reading order (price, then caption, URL and list), but the white card is gone and all of the text block is shrunk to near-illegible size. That leaves a big dead gap in the middle and no strong focal point.
